text:
**Short answer:** The Anker 735 (Nano II 65W) is the safest all-round pick for a laptop plus a phone. It's $29.99 at Newegg: [Anker 735 on Newegg](https://www.newegg.com/p/359-00D8-002C3).

**Power split:** Anker's spec sheet says one device gets up to 65W from either USB-C port. With a laptop and a phone plugged into the two USB-C ports, you get 45W + 20W. That's fine for a MacBook Air or similar, but a laptop that needs the full 65W will charge slower while the phone is connected. Put the laptop on the 45W port. ([Anker spec](https://service.anker.com/product-description/a085g000004x2BVAAY), [Newegg listing](https://www.newegg.com/p/359-00D8-002C3))

**Other good options:**
- **Baseus Enercore (67W):** Tom's Hardware named it best in the 65W range. It held full wattage throughout testing, ran the coolest of the chargers they tested, and costs $29.99. It also has a built-in retractable USB-C cable and two more USB-C ports. See [Tom's Hardware's best USB chargers](https://www.tomshardware.com/peripherals/usb/best-usb-chargers).
- **UGREEN Nexode Pro 65W:** Smart Gadget Kit's top pick. It has three ports, weighs 113g, and ships with US, UK and EU plug heads. They report the same 45W + 20W split with two devices. I didn't get a direct buy link, so see the [review and price links](https://smartgadgetkit.com/best-gan-charger/).
- **Baseus GaN5 Pro 65W (2-pack):** $49.99 for two chargers, one for home and one for your bag. It supports PPS for Samsung Galaxy fast charging, and it splits 45W + 20W with two devices. This is an affiliate link: [Baseus GaN5 Pro 2-pack](https://dealectric.com/go/baseus-gan5-pro-65w-2c-u). No discount code worked when it was tested on 2026-10-24.

**Things to check:**
- If you have a Samsung phone and want Super Fast Charging 2.0, you need PPS. Anker's spec sheet lists PPS for the 735, but one review site says it lacks it, so I'd treat that as unconfirmed. The Baseus GaN5 Pro explicitly lists it.
- None of these include a cable, except the Baseus Enercore's built-in one. Use a 60W-or-higher USB-C cable for the laptop.
- The review sites disagree on some Anker port numbers, so I used Anker's own spec above.

If you tell me your laptop model, I can check whether 45W is enough for it or if you'd be better off with a 100W charger.
